card.name: The word supplied in packaging descriptions
card.fires_on: The word "supplied" (or its middle piece "sup-plied") right after a drug product name, introducing how it comes packaged, such as vials or syringes. It also fires weakly on a few other words in instructions, like vial or meter face.

modes.label: Supplied in
modes.description: The word supplied after an injection or drug name, before the container type.
modes.example: Succinylcholine chloride injection<< supplied>> in single-dose prefilled syring

modes.label: Split word sup-plied
modes.description: The second half of supplied when it is split, in parentheses after a product name.
modes.example: constitute oseltamivir phosphate for oral suspension (sup<<plied>> as powder)

modes.label: Container words
modes.description: Weaker firing on container or device words such as vial in handling instructions.

card.plain: It lights up on the word "supplied" when a label says how a drug is packaged.
